title: ToolContractGate: Versioned Trusted Contracts for Drift-Safe Agent Tool Invocation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33108v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent tool approval and input validation do not, by themselves, bind a request to an approved source artifact. ToolContractGate provides a deterministic runtime contract evaluator for OpenAPI-derived agent tools. Each versioned ToolContract combines a stored OpenAPI fingerprint with access, schema, and behavioral declarations. The full evaluator applies ten checks, including a cached boot-time provenance result; four execution modes and five evaluation configurations support baseline, ablation, and non-blocking shadow analysis. On a synthetic benchmark of 45 cases (35 unsafe cases across 12 drift classes and 10 safe cases), the full pipeline detects all 35 faults: 29 BLOCK, 3 REVIEW, and 3 WARN decisions, with no false blocks on the safe cases. The archived run reports a mean gate latency of 0.18 ms and a 95th percentile (p95) of 2 ms using integer-millisecond measurements. The open-source artifact includes seven OpenAPI specifications,

translated_title: ToolContractGate：面向漂移安全的代理工具调用的版本化可信合约
translated_abstract: 代理工具审批与输入验证本身并不能将请求绑定到已批准的源工件上。ToolContractGate 为基于 OpenAPI 派生的代理工具提供了一个确定性的运行时合约评估器。每个版本化的 ToolContract 将存储的 OpenAPI 指纹与访问、模式（schema）及行为声明相结合。完整评估器执行十项检查，其中包括缓存的启动时溯源结果；四种执行模式和五种评估配置支持基线、消融以及非阻塞的影子分析。在一个包含 45 个案例的合成基准测试中（涵盖 12 类漂移的 35 个不安全案例和 10 个安全案例），完整流水线检测出全部 35 个故障：29 个 BLOCK（阻断）、3 个 REVIEW（审查）和 3 个 WARN（警告）决策，且对安全案例没有产生误阻断。存档运行记录显示，采用整数毫秒测量时，门控平均延迟为 0.18 毫秒，第 95 百分位数（p95）为 2 毫秒。开源工件包含七个 OpenAPI 规范……
tldr: 提出 ToolContractGate，通过版本化可信合约将代理工具调用请求与已批准的 OpenAPI 源工件确定性绑定，在无误阻断的前提下检测出全部 35 个漂移故障，且平均门控延迟仅 0.18 毫秒。
